sources.title: telecomadm1145/Kiseki-TTS · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A small, fast Japanese TTS model with a Mamba2 state-space decoder, built on top of Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-Tokenizer-12Hz. Kiseki-TTS generates discrete neural audio codec tokens at 12.5 Hz and decodes them to waveform with the Qwen3 TTS codec.
